description: This file contains the PHP class 'Cron' within the Opencart\-Catalog\-Model\-Setting namespace. The class provides methods to manage cron jobs in the OpenCart system, including editing cron entries, fetching cron details, and retrieving lists and counts of crons.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing cron job records in the database, including editing, fetching, and listing cron entries.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the 'date_modified' timestamp of a specific cron entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific cron entry.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific cron entry by its ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Fetches a cron entry based on its unique code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Returns a list of all cron entries ordered by their last modification date.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total number of cron entries in the database.
